CC-AUTH.invariant: login.sqlite3 journal_mode DELETE, exactly two STRICT tables, caps of 32 grants/sessions, grant consume + session insert in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE, O_NOFOLLOW + dev/ino identity checks, fchmod 0600/0700, link()-based atomic create, dir fsync; the CLI never bootstraps the DB; tokens never logged. The server holds one AccessDb client for the dashboard HTTP server lifetime and forge uses its own per-operation client in the CLI process; never two clients in one process.

CC-BINDING-GEN.invariant: UI and API results are applied only to the exact project/main/binding generation that requested them.

CC-BINDING-MERGE.invariant: stale full-document binding writes keep the stored stopNotice/supervisionStop; other fields last-writer-wins.

CC-CATALOG.invariant: Store service shape unchanged; ingest is one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction that advances the cursor only on success; T3 Ack only after onItem succeeds; environment binding, scrub-at-open, 50k thread cap, 512 KB documents.

CC-CLI.invariant: commands start and auth forge with --data-dir; --help/-h help on stdout exit 0; usage errors exit 2; forge success stdout is exactly the token line with empty stderr; absolute paths only; --data-dir over DATA_DIRECTORY; shebang warning suppression; behaviour changes limited to BC-CLI-01..04

CC-CLOCK-ELAPSED.invariant: in-memory budgets and deadlines use monotonic time (Clock.monotonicTimeNanos or Effect.timeout/sleep); a wall-clock jump never enlarges or shrinks them; durations unchanged (60 s cooldowns, 5 s throttles, 20/30 s native deadlines, 120 s cycle timeout, 5 s after-cycle spacing, 400 ms evidence budget, 5000 ms stream deadlines)

CC-CLOCK-WALL.invariant: persisted timestamps, TTLs, cooldowns compared across restarts and session expiry use wall Clock.currentTimeMillis where the baseline used Date.now; native event times are copied untouched; TestClock never replaces native timestamps

CC-CONFIG.invariant: same env names, defaults and validation (invalid_helper_provider_instance_id); the mutable threadPolicy and supervisorOwnedThreadIds fields become services in the same commit as all readers.

CC-CONTROL.invariant: every control has its own generation CAS (master, project, No Project, global definitions); No Project default {generation:0, mode:'on_request'}; global definitions default off and never activate No Project.
pins: No Project defaults to On request and shared definitions never activate a chat

CC-DBFILES.invariant: per-file journal mode and pragmas exactly as today (catalog/guidance/thread-settings WAL + listed pragmas; login DELETE + exact two-table schema); one client per file; no SqliteMigrator; no settings shared across files.

CC-DEFS.invariant: definitions revision = sha256 of [projectId, threadId, root, scratch, inputs], set only when complete; namespaced global ids deterministic; both persisted in task and workflow pins.

CC-FILEMODES.invariant: data dir 0700, database files 0600 including -wal/-shm (catalog chmods on open/commit/close; guidance/thread-policy chmod before WAL); SqliteClient enables WAL inside make, so files are created/chmodded 0600 before the layer opens them.

CC-FILES.invariant: writer failures after send -> unavailable mapped to uncertain by the editor, never retried; committer abort/close/timeout(30 s) -> uncertain; actionId is a content hash (stable identity).

CC-GDB.invariant: guidance.sqlite3 is served by exactly one connection; transaction(f) = BEGIN IMMEDIATE + synchronous body; receipts, native proof, workflow edits, acknowledgements and Stop state that commit together today commit in one transaction after the port (one SqliteClient for the file, transaction context propagated through the fiber, no native/HTTP/fs I/O or forks inside withTransaction).

CC-GDB-IMPLICIT.invariant: multi-statement read-modify-write sequences without a transaction are atomic today only because synchronous JS runs to completion (guidance-store observe/reserveTokens/prune/resolveEpisode, conversation-store prepare/saveAgreement*, team-store pre-checks, project-supervisor-store saveTask/saveStart/observeModel/chatStop/activation, git-probe add/removePending, helper-transport authority check -> receipt); each becomes one withTransaction in S6d and stays inside one Effect.sync section before.

CC-HEALTH.invariant: 0.0.0.0:HEALTH_PORT, exact /health and /live paths (query string -> 404 empty), body {ok, readiness, ...status}, 200/503, any method; compose healthcheck depends on it.

CC-HELPER-RECEIPT.invariant: exact sent bytes and write-once rendering/message id/contradiction in supervisor_helper_deliveries; one owner per table (team-controller/team-view raw reads become owner read methods).

CC-HTTPAPI.invariant: SupervisorApi endpoints, payload/response Schemas and error encodings stay wire-identical for server (guidance-ui.ts) and client (ui/src/api.ts AtomHttpApi).

CC-IDS.invariant: persisted identity formats (supervisor-review:<id>, supervisor-notice:workflow:<taskId>, supervisor-objective:<taskId>, supervisor-create:<thread>:<generation>, supervisor-settle:<uuid>, team-ready/team-review/guide/supervisor-helper ids, UUIDv4) never change; ids come from one Ids/Crypto service so tests can pin them.

CC-INTERP.invariant: interpretation command persisted 'dispatching' before RPC; definite rejection -> unavailable, other failures -> uncertain; missing run replayed with the same identity at most 2 times; creation at most 3 attempts under supervisor-create:<thread>:<generation>.

CC-INTERP-SUBMIT.invariant: interpretation results arrive only through supervision_interpretation_submit; one attempt is the immutable key (binding generation, task ID, source revision and hash, dispatched request message ID and text hash) with a service-minted attemptId, so a source edit or definitions renewal of the same task ID is a new attempt; authority is the bound root's own executed strong main-run tool item with canonically equal raw arguments, inside the run started by the attempt's request message; binding, target and route come from the task, never from arguments; intake runs inside the admission section (3.11), looks up an existing receipt for the attemptId before the attempt-state gate, and CASes one immutable receipt per attempt into the existing workflow receipt table (namespace interpretation, operation = attemptId); identical replays return the original receipt, changed content conflicts, superseded attempts are stale; the tool returns immediately and wakes the scope, never waiting for its own run; finalization happens only in reconcile after a successful completed run of the exact request, re-verifying the full native proof before every application including a bare Start, then refreshing source, boundary, definitions, control and binding; pending Start uses a narrow interpretation permission; candidate evidence is a discriminated union (interpretation_submission, supervisor_message) shared by proposalEvidenceCurrent and agreementEvidenceCurrent; the tool never sends; a submission is never an agreement; no final-chat interpretation text is parsed, while later negotiated proposal and acceptance protocols are retained; the one-off cut-over closes in-flight JSON-only requests unapplied after their runs end, keeps retained candidates and agreements valid only by verified hash, records candidate-free inferred or provisional interpretations once as supervisor_message evidence with plan digest and source pin on the task record (or stale with the baseline result), keeps unknown introductions with exact IDs, body and route, and never sends

CC-MCP.invariant: stateless Streamable HTTP at /mcp/workflows (no Mcp-Session-Id), JSON responses, 1 MiB body, 9 s per call, abort on client close, tool list order, isError reasons; Host allowlist 127.0.0.1:<port> + WORKFLOW_MCP_HOSTS; Origin/sec-fetch-site rejection; bearer = workflow-mcp-token; MCPX connects directly (no proxy).

CC-MONITOR-ACK.invariant: frozen activity batches are acknowledged only at their exact version inside the caller's transaction.

CC-NATIVE.invariant: outcome classification: before send -> rejected (not definite); after sent=true any close/error/timeout(20 s)/abort/malformed frame -> uncertain; Exit Failure -> rejected+definite only for OrchestratorCommandPreviouslyRejectedError or ThreadManagementProviderInstanceDisabledError; dispatchCommandFailure only for orchestration.dispatchCommand with OrchestrationV2DispatchCommandError; uncertain is never re-sent under a fresh id.

CC-NESTTX.invariant: join-if-in-transaction else open (db.isTransaction) and caller-owned *InTransaction APIs become nested withTransaction (SAVEPOINT/RELEASE); no inner failure is caught inside an outer transaction today, so savepoint semantics change nothing; a caught inner failure would need an explicit ledger entry.

CC-NOPROJECT-DEFAULT.invariant: On request remains the No Project default in store, API and UI presentation; shared definitions never activate No Project.

CC-OVERVIEW-RANGE.invariant: readOverviewRange pages by 100 and keeps the previous read on failure.

CC-OWNED.invariant: registerMember must not add an owned id before the outermost commit (latent phantom id on rollback today); the port updates the in-memory set after commit or reads from the DB.

CC-OWNERSHIP.invariant: owned Supervisor thread ids are loaded before catalog filtering; ids join the shared set only after commit; the supervisor-root: prefix is retained.

CC-PROBE.invariant: pending {threadId, terminalId} persisted before terminal.open, removed only after successful terminal.close; cleanup at start, before each probe and at scope release; only UUIDv4 ids closable; probes serialized.

CC-PROOF.invariant: native authority: exact own-main-run dynamic_tool item with canonically equal arguments; pending vs denied split; foreign, stale, streaming, child and self-reported records never prove anything.

CC-RECEIPT-FIRST.invariant: a durable sending/posting/uncertain/prepared record with the final native identity is committed before the native effect; crash/abort/interrupt after it yields an unknown outcome reconciled only under the same identity; no Effect.retry/Schedule/HttpClient.retry around dispatchCommand or webhook POST.

CC-RECOVERY.invariant: on open: notices committed -> not_delivered_restart (dispatch_started=0) or uncertain (=1) with one process_recovery activity each; team sending -> uncertain; Start preparing -> rejected; uncertain items block new commits until reconciled/accepted.

CC-REDACT.invariant: no credential, token, cookie or Authorization value, native error body, capability URL (webhook path) or raw cause in logs, spans, errors or HTTP bodies; logs and spans carry only sanitized typed classifications

CC-SCOPE-SERIAL.invariant: run/reconcile/check of one Supervisor scope never overlap (serial(scopeKey)); bindings processed in batches of 4; MCP calls are not serialized and rely on transactional CAS. Port: RcMap<scopeKey, Semaphore> (Scanner namespacedLock pattern).

CC-SETUP-FENCE.invariant: supervision setup fence latches on uncertainty and blocks other control changes until a verified read.

CC-SHUTDOWN.invariant: SIGINT/SIGTERM interrupt the main fiber; exit 0 / 130 / errorExitCode; supervision and listeners released before stores (intended change of today's order, decision D-10); git-probe cleanup bounded; in-flight UI requests aborted.

CC-SQL-LIFETIME.invariant: four named interfaces CatalogDb/GuidanceDb/PolicyDb/AccessDb; exactly one client per file at a time; lifetimes as today (catalog and policy per process, guidance and the server's access client per supervision run, forge's access client per CLI operation in its own process); never two clients for one file in one process; transactions contain SQL only; interrupted waiters complete after the holder releases; failed COMMIT cleaned before reuse

CC-START.invariant: one receipt per (thread, operationId) with requestHash; preparing -> final only while preparing; restart turns preparing into rejected; the Start verdict commits task + permission in one guidance transaction; ui-pending Starts are activated or rejected next cycle.

CC-START-FENCE.invariant: a retained browser Start intent (threadId, operationId) blocks new Starts until a terminal status; an unknown POST outcome never clears it; the same operationId is used for status checks.

CC-STATUS.invariant: status written by 4 fibers; t3Connected true only after first ingested item, false on watch exit; heartbeat 30 s; alive < 60 s.

CC-STOP.invariant: a per-chat human Stop fences every new send; it dates from the human message, a later Enable wins, replay never re-dates, one notice per Enable period; the stop list (thread-settings.sqlite3) and guidance.sqlite3 are never in one transaction and writes are ordered policy-first; Stop/send ordering follows CC-STOP-LIN.

CC-STOP-LIN.invariant: policy reads stay authoritative database reads (no snapshot); one process-wide admission section orders Stop/Enable/thread-policy/Start-activation commits and their guidance bookkeeping against every fresh send's final guard, receipt commit and native admission (the adapter's synchronous initiate handoff) and against every policy-dependent durable write; no lock across network I/O; uninterruptible around commit+bookkeeping and receipt+admission; an admitted send keeps its identity and reconciles, never cancelled or replayed; the two-file crash gap and L-01..L-04 are preserved, not widened

targetContract.admission: one process-wide Semaphore(1) owned by SupervisionGate: admit(f) = Semaphore.withPermits(admission, 1)(Effect.uninterruptible(f(guard))); supersedes the per-scope draft
covers: Stop, Enable, thread-policy saves, chat-supervision changes and Start activation: policy commit then guidance bookkeeping
every fresh send: final guard, durable receipt, native admission
every policy-dependent durable write: guard and write (workflow_write, supervision_team mutations, typed intake and finalization, Start activation and the policyDependentMutations inventory)
targetContract.nativeAdmission: the adapter's synchronous initiate(request): Effect<InFlight {result, release}> (Effect.sync) that binds the WS request frame to a created socket sent on open, or invokes fetch with the body; a fork alone is not admission
targetContract.inFlightLookup: inside admit and before any initiation: FiberMap.get(map, identity) returns a duplicate handle (nothing initiated); else an existing durable receipt returns the reconciliation-only outcome (never a new send); else receipt commit, initiate and FiberMap.run(map, identity, operation) in the same masked body; onlyIfMissing is not used (4.0.5 returns an interrupted sentinel for an existing key, FiberMap.ts:1427-1428)
targetContract.resourceOwnership: the registered operation is InFlight.result mapped to the path's baseline outcome classification (total; never fails the map) with Effect.ensuring(release); FiberMap.run forks it as an interruptible daemon fiber owned by the adapter-lifetime map, so no interruptible point lies between initiate and the registered release; adapter scope close interrupts it and runs release once
targetContract.cancellationOwner: the initiating caller only: the owner cell is filled inside the section and the send runs under Effect.onInterrupt(() => Fiber.interrupt(owned)), so request abort, the cycle deadline or calling-scope shutdown interrupts the mapped operation and awaits release; the outcome follows the baseline abort classification under the original identity; duplicates join with Effect.exit(Fiber.join) and never cancel or replace the original; an interrupted exit seen by a duplicate falls back to the receipt reconciliation; Stop never touches the map
targetContract.evidence: docs/effect-v4-admission-probe.mjs on effect 4.0.5: 8/8 cases (plan 3.11, below CT-LIN-05)
targetContract.capability: the guard used for writes and sends is reachable only through admit
targetContract.lockOrder: ScopeLocks key (if held) -> admission section -> database critical section; never acquired inside a transaction (CT-LIN-07)
targetContract.introduced: S6a, together with the legacy policy writers (T-07)
targetContract.admittedSend: keeps its identity; never cancelled, replayed or rerouted by Stop
targetContract.crashGap: two files committed policy-first; preserved and documented

CC-SYNC-ATOMIC.invariant: every baseline synchronous block (DB or in-memory read-check-write) maps to one Effect.sync section, Ref.modify, SynchronizedRef or Semaphore-guarded section; every baseline await window between check and write keeps exactly that window.
pins: target-regression forced-yield variants after each port

CC-T3RPC.invariant: native T3 RPC frames are the effect/rpc RpcMessage protocol (Request/Ack/Ping/Pong/Chunk/Exit); Ack only after successful processing; per-call maxPayload (32/8/2/2 MiB); binary frames rejected; one socket per call.

CC-TEAM-EPOCH.invariant: member epoch + assignment epoch + coverage CAS on every helper write, request, assessment, notice and guide; quarantine terminal.

CC-UI-DRAFTS.invariant: drafts survive reloads, session expiry and re-sign-in; dirty fields are never overwritten by background reads; sign-out blocked while drafts or pending operations exist.

CC-UI-MUTATION.invariant: queries keyed by the full scope tuple cancel on change; mutations are admitted once per user action and never interrupted by scope change, unmount, auth refresh, refetch, runtime rebuild or a second invocation; keep-alive (scope, operationId) ownership with duplicate suppression and retained outcome shown only for the original scope; unknown outcomes keep their durable fence until a verified read; nothing replays a mutation

CC-UI-SESSION.invariant: session token only in localStorage; responses for a changed session ignored; 401 clears only its own session; cross-tab storage events reset access; credentials 'omit'.

CC-WEBSEC.invariant: exact Host/Origin/CSRF/session check order, JSON {message} bodies, security headers; /auth/*, /api/csrf and static files outside HttpApi; 413/500 fallbacks; MCP-only listener derives Origin from the UI port.

CC-WFCAS.invariant: UPDATE ... AND revision=? with changes===1 and the receipt in the same transaction; *InTransaction methods require the caller's transaction.

CC-WFPLAN.invariant: canonicalJson, fingerprint (sha256 of JSON.stringify), seeded node ids, compactProposalDigest and stateHash are persisted identities and stay byte-identical.

CC-WFRECEIPT.invariant: workflow write receipts keyed by owner, generation, namespace, operationId, requestHash; exact replay before evidence checks; pending never reserves; one native item per operation.

CC-WSFRAME.invariant: one shared envelope implementation replaces the 6 hand-written copies (t3.ts, supervisor-native.ts, git-probe.ts, project-files.ts x3) without changing frames, limits, close or error handling (decisions D-08/D-09).
